The algorithm adapts to environmental changes by making full use of quantum populations to introduce population diversity and affects the search direction of antibody populations for multiobjective GEP, so that antibody populations have better evolutionary ability. The results on three continuous dynamic multiobjective test functions show that the QGEP Dynamic algorithm is superior to traditional genetic algorithm in terms of solution distribution breadth and stability.

articleTitle: Research on Web Application Anomaly Intrusion Detection Model Based On Massive Logs
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Web log data in university application system is an important source of system operation and maintenance and security analysis. Based on MapReduce architecture, combined with the learning and detection model of attribute length, character distribution characteristics and attribute domain enumeration, this paper presents a massive data intrusion detection learning model and detection algorithm. The system operation results show that the platform can effectively find abnormal intrusion in the campus network, has high retrieval efficiency, and can effectively provide operation and maintenance efficiency and abnormal troubleshooting speed.

articleTitle: Research on Problems, Challenges and Opportunities Based on Internet of Things (IoTs) and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As the exponential growth of the Industrial Internet of Things(IoTs),a massive amount of data is generated gradually by multiple channels. It is not advisable to store all local raw data in an international IoTs device, which lies in the fact that the power and stora ge space of the end device are severely confined by self-organization. In this paper, research is conducted on the Internet of Things(IoTs) and cloud computing to provide solutions to problems in cloud compatibility and computing technologies to facilitate a stable transition from IoTs applications to cloud computing.

articleTitle: Global Feature Extraction Graph Neural Networks for Session Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The recommender system based on session sequence is mainly used for the recommendation task when the user information is scarce. Usually, the user session is expressed as an ordered sequence of items. However, learning user preferences from ordered sequences is a complex problem in deep learning based recommender system. This paper proposes a novel model, the Global Feature Extraction Graph Neural Network for Session Recommendation (GFE-GNN), which transforms the session sequence from sequential representation to graphical representation. While obtaining the sequence order, the global graph feature extraction is used to obtain the potential sequence of items, so as to learn the complex preferences of users. Finally, the problem of predicting the next item of the session is transformed into a graph classification problem through the aggregation layer. Experimental results on real datasets show that GFE-GNN is superior to the most advanced session recommendation methods.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Power Line Detection System Based on 5G and RV1126
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The detection of power lines is an important part of modern industrial and urban life. To assure the reliability of these components, power providers spend a lot of money and time doing frequent inspections and maintenance. The goal of research is to automate the detection process by finding solutions to meet a variety of standards, in this paper we employ power line specific knowledge to design an embedded power line detecting system based on 5G and RV1126. In this paper we first studies the implementation principle and architecture of embedded network video transmission system, then introduced the design scheme of a detection system based on 5G and RV1126 chip, as well as an embedded Linux development environment. The hardware development platform of the system is analysed and the corresponding software environment is built. The overall design scheme of the system is proposed, the design and implementation of the main modules of the system are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of China's Economic Cooperation with the “Belt and Road” Countries from a Cross-Cultural Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the gradual deepening of economic globalization, the frequency of cross-cultural business cooperation between countries has gradually increased. Whether at the macro or micro level, communication obstacles and economic losses caused by different cultural backgrounds to the economic exchanges of countries are also increasing. This paper selects the economic cooperation data (2014–2021) of 29 countries along the “Belt and Road” that have economic relations with China, uses Hofstede's cultural index to calculate the cultural distance between China and these countries along the route, and uses the extended gravity model to conduct empirical tests, The result shows that cultural distance does have an impact on bilateral economic cooperation, and there are differences due to regional differences.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Ship Electromechanical Equipment based on Improved Outlier Detection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to ensure the uninterrupted transmission of power or electric energy in a ship, it is necessary to locate the fault part timely and accurately, which mainly relies on the fault classifier to identify the fault characteristics. In the process of classifier recognition, there will be some unfiltered noise signals to interfere with it and affect the classifier recognition results. In order to solve such problems, an intelligent fault diagnosis algorithm is established through the pattern recognition method described by classification Support Vector Data Description, so that machine learning technology can play an important role in the fault diagnosis of marine electromechanical equipment. The performance of the proposed algorithm can accurately identify various possible faults, and the fault diagnosis performance is better than that of the traditional ship's generator fault diagnosis model.

articleTitle: A Distributed Relay Selection and Bandwidth Allocation Method Based on Interference Level for HPLC and Micro-power Wireless Integration
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: High-speed Power Line Carrier (HPLC) and micropower wireless can coordinate and supply each other by taking advantages of each channel, so in this paper, a distributed relay selection and bandwidth allocation method based on interference level is proposed, which can adaptively establish multi-hop transmission network by dynamically adjusting the transmission relays and bandwidth resource allocation based on channel conditions. This method can significantly improve the data acquisition rate of the concentrator by fully multiplexing the bandwidth through controlling the mutual interference.

Author Keywords: HPLC and micro power wireless integration

articleTitle: Research on Performance Evaluation of Government Data Open Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the digital age, data has a great impact on politics, economy and society. It's the government's response to the changes in the information age that promote the opening of government data and build an open platform for government data. The paper constructs a set of evaluation index system of open government data. Based on BSC model, it takes the strategic target of government data open platform as the core and starts from four dimensions of output, users, carrier and operation guarantee. It is helpful for the performance evaluation of local government data open platform in China and provides practical guidance for the development of government data open platform.

articleTitle: A multi-model Imputation Approach for Missing Data Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the process of big data analysis, the consistency and integrity of the data are very important factors that affect the correctness of the analysis results in most cases. Usually before the data analysis process starts, data clustering should be made on the collected data sources to hold that subsequent analysis will not cause errors in the results due to data abnormalities. Therefore, maintaining integrity in data clustering is one of those very important work. One principal reason for the incomplete data is that the collected data contains missing values, and the appearance of missing values comes from factors such as carelessness and instrument failure during the data collection process. At present, the common ways to deal with missing values are as follows: directly ignore the tuples with missing values, or use the median, mean etc. of the missing values attribute to impute. The simple application of these methods often results in the loss of the original features of the tuple, which affects the subsequent data analysis and application output, leading to incorrect results. In response to this problem, our research uses machine learning methods to impute missing values in a single field. We choose complete and consistent data samples as the training datasets, and divide the data into multiple clusters by K-means clustering to capture the associations which are not easily visible between the data. These clusters use multiple linear regression and artificial neural networks to establish predictive models. For the missing values that need to be predicted, first of all we use the KNN algorithm to obtain the cluster to which the data belongs, and then apply the cluster model to calculate the predicted value. In the experiment, it is proved that the multi-model imputation method proposed by this research is better than the existing imputation methods in the results of the statistical accuracy of Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE).

articleTitle: Distributed Music Comments Mining System Based on BGLL Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper aims to establish a distributed music comments mining system based on BGLL algorithm. With the massive music resource and users of NetEase Cloud Music, our system employs big data technology and machine learning technology to analyze data from the perspective of comments, discover users' attitudes towards the song or the music. The whole system is built based on the Hadoop ecosystem, and it includes four main modules: data acquisition, data storage, data analysis, and data visualization. A python based web crawler is used for data acquisition on NetEase Cloud Music resource, then the distributed HDFS system is built for data processing and analyzing. A refined mining algorithm based on BGLL is implemented for topic mining procedure. At last, a word cloud map is generated based on javaweb technology. Experiments show that our system can perfome well on the comment topic mining application, due to the distributed architecture, our system has a potential capability on dealing with large scale of data.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Delay-control of Hopf Bifurcation and Stability Switches in a Generlized Logistic Model
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: A generlized Logistic model with nonlinear delayed harvest controlling is considered. The conditions for the stability and local Hopf bifurcation of the equilibrium point are obtained. Numerical examples show that our control strategy can not only control the Hopf bifurcation of the system, but also control the stability switches phenomenon. These are all very useful for the survival of the population.

articleTitle: On Interpretable Algorithm of Artificial Intelligence based on Information Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The high-speed development and wide application of artificial intelligence technology have brought great convenience to human beings and strongly promoted the degree of social intelligence. However, due to the complexity and huge structure of artificial intelligence algorithm model, its algorithm operation process and calculation method have some shortcomings such as opacity. The lack of strict interpretable results will inevitably bring a certain degree of hidden dangers to production and life. In this paper, different interpretable artificial intelligence algorithms are used to analyze and mine information networks. Through designing multiple groups of experiments, the performance of different algorithm models is verified and analyzed, and the interpretable process mechanism of artificial intelligence algorithms and the future research prospects and directions are explored.

articleTitle: Research on Prototype System for Electromagnetic Spectrum Management and Control Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Controlling electromagnetic space has become an important support for the fight for comprehensive control over the battlefield. How to effectively use limited electromagnetic spectrum resources has become a major problem that restricts future operations. The GIS-based electromagnetic spectrum management and control prototype system can provide commanders with spectrum planning and frequency assignment suggestions, and give full play to the combat effectiveness of frequency equipment. First introduced the basic structure of the prototype system and the overview of the command and equipment side; then designed the system composition and the command side workflow of the prototype system; finally, in order to demonstrate the effectiveness of the prototype system, use the border conflict as the background to distinguish the pre-war spectrum The electromagnetic spectrum is managed and controlled in three situations: assignment, suffering from ground-based fixed interference and suffering from space-based mobile interference. Through teaching and training practice, it is helpful to effectively use electromagnetic spectrum resources and avoid intentional interference, and has certain promotion and application value

articleTitle: Optimization of Industrial Water System Based on Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Construct water system structure of thermal power plant based on decentralized wastewater treatment network which is composed of water consuming units and wastewater treatment units. Based on this structure, a nonconvex optimization problem is proposed in this paper and the present mathematical method cannot guarantee the exact solution. So we propose Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm to solve this complex model. Apply this algorithm to the solution of two examples, the solving process of examples shows that ABC algorithm has the advantages of fast solving speed, high solving accuracy and has a strong adaptability to different situations without relying on an initial point.

Author Keywords: water system model of thermal power plant

articleTitle: Research on Eigenvalue Decomposition Algorithm: —Based on Polarization Calibration
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Due to the randomness of the initial phase of the vector network analyzer, there will be a large error when the polarization characteristic parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{H}/\overline{\alpha}$</tex> measured by using it. In this paper, a method of measuring and calibrating the full polarization scattering matrix by using vector network analyzer is proposed to obtain the polarization characteristic parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{H}/\overline{\alpha}$</tex>. Firstly, the measurement system of the full polarization scattering matrix is constructed, and then the polarization scattering matrix is calibrated by the disk, 0°and 22.5°dihedrals. Finally, the error caused by the randomness of the initial phase of the vector network analyzer is eliminated, and the accurate measurement of the polarization characteristic parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{H}/\overline{\alpha}$</tex> is realized. The results show that the error of the scattering angle <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\overline{\alpha}$</tex> obtained by polarization calibration is less than 3 degrees compared with the theoretical value, which indicates that the polarization characteristic parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{H}/\overline{\alpha}$</tex> of the target can be accurately obtained by measuring and calibrating the amplitude and phase of the polarization scattering matrix.

articleTitle: HED-CNN based Ionospheric Clutter Extraction for HF Range-Doppler Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: High Frequency Surface Wave Radar (HFSWR) suffers seriously with the ionospheric clutter formed from ionosphere echoes. The ionospheric clutter could be extensive and exists all day long, which restricts the detection performance of HFSWR. It is necessary to eliminate the interference of ionospheric clutter which overwhelms target echoes always. However, there is not a prior knowledge about clutter each work cycle, and anti-ionospheric interference technology adapting to all kinds of situations. With the purpose of extracting the ionospheric clutter separately for clutter cancellation, image processing method is adopted to study and analyze the application of deep learning in edge extraction of ionospheric clutter existing in Range-Doppler (RD) spectrum. In this paper, holistically-nested edge detection (HED) based algorithm is adopted and Canny algorithm is used for comparison. It shows that HED algorithm is effective and efficient in edge extraction of ionospheric clutter in RD spectrum.

articleTitle: Application of Information Technology in Output-oriented Flipped Classroom of English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The rapid development of technology has sparked a revolution in the world of education and flipped classroom is one form of pedagogy that stems from the proliferation of technology, providing the learners with the technological support and preparing the learners with the information literacy for the output-oriented learning in flipped classroom. Technology acts as an intermediary for flipped learning and as a way to the enhancement of the interaction and collaboration for flipped classroom. Technology plays an indispensable role in English output-oriented flipped classroom and in turn it contributes a lot to the information sharing, diverse assessment and timely feedback, hence promoting the effectiveness of flipped teaching and learning.

articleTitle: A Fault Prediction Method for Water Pump Based on BP Neural Network and Improved Dempster-Shafer Theory of Evidence
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to improve the fault prediction accuracy of the water pump, a Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) is applied to the vibration signals on the horizontal, vertical directions and driving end of the pump, and the marginal spectral energy was taken as feature vectors. Then three BP neural networks are used to make local prediction according to feature vectors of three parts of the pump, and establish the fault type matrix. The output of BP neural network is normalized into the Basic Probability Assignment (BPA) of Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory propositions. Then the decision-level information fusion of D-S evidence theory is carried out for the three evidence bodies. Aiming at the limitation of D-S evidence theory in dealing with conflicting evidence, an improved fusion method based on Jousselme distance is proposed. This method takes into account the credibility of each evidence body to the recognition of proposition. The simulation test shows that the proposed method can improve the fault prediction accuracy of water pump and has the feasibility of its application in fault prediction of water pump equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Types of LSA in OSPF Multiarea Network Based on ENSP
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: OSPF is a widely used link state routing protocol in Internet. In large enterprises, areas are used in OSPF to design networks. In different OSPF areas, routers generate different LSAS according to their respective roles. Various LSAS work together to generate a routing table for each router. This paper will analyze and research the types of LSA in OSPF multiarea network.

articleTitle: Analysis of Current situation and Countermeasures of Performance Evaluation of Volunteers in Large-scale Games Based on Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Using the methods of literature and interview, this paper analyzes the current situation of performance evaluation of volunteers in large-scale games based on mobile Internet, By analyzing the popularity of mobile Internet, the convenience of performance evaluation, the security and privacy of performance evaluation, this paper demonstrates the necessity of performance evaluation of volunteers in large-scale games based on mobile Internet, This paper puts forward the Countermeasures of performance evaluation of volunteers in large-scale games based on mobile Internet.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Path of Network Marketing Wisdom Classroom in Application-Oriented Undergraduate under the Background of “Internet +”
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Application-oriented undergraduate colleges and universities shoulder the significant responsibility of training comprehensive applied high-quality talents in the field of network marketing for China. Under the background of “Internet +” era, the social demand for network marketing practical talents is increasing day by day, which puts forward higher requirements for the training of network marketing talents in application-oriented undergraduate colleges and universities. Accordingly, this paper constructs the wisdom classroom path of application-oriented undergraduate university network marketing to promote the deep integration of information technology and applied education, which comprehensively improves the education and teaching quality of application-oriented undergraduate.

articleTitle: Exploration and Research on The Training Path of Accounting Professionals Under The Background of “New Mode And New Value” Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As the digitalization process continues to advance, the scope of application of digital technology continues to expand, especially in the fields of finance and management. In the future, enterprises will inevitably establish financial and financial resource information bases through digital technology, and rely more on mid-to-high-end talents who effectively integrate financial and data analysis. Up to now, the training methods and means of financial accounting students in most colleges and universities follow the convention, which can not make the students' practical operation ability and data analysis ability keep pace with the times, resulting in the mismatch between the students trained by the school and the talents needed by the society. In response to the above problems, this paper discusses the possibility and achievability of adjusting the direction and goals of talent training by optimizing curriculum design and content, and strengthening the transformation of teachers' teaching methods, which will improve the degree of adaptation between students and enterprises, and then provide suggestions for the connection and integration of education and industry.

articleTitle: Anti-noise Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Fault diagnosis methods based on deep learning have a strong ability to distinguish faults with unknown mechanisms in the field of mechanical fault diagnosis. However, when the noise interference is strong, the accuracy of the model will decrease to a certain extent. This paper proposes an anti-noise fault diagnosis model named APR-CNN. The model is designed based on a two-dimensional convolutional neural network, which uses the wavelet time-frequency images as input. According to the characteristic of the periodic transformation of the wavelet time-frequency image of the bearing signals, average pooling on rows method is used to compress the time domain information and extract the features effectively. Compared with classical methods on the open-source bearing fault dataset, experiments show that the APR-CNN model can still have an accuracy rate of 98% even in a noisy environment with SNR of −10, which is at least 30% higher than other methods.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Law Popularization Model Based on Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Law popularization has always been an important basic work to comprehensively promote the strategy of governing the country according to law. The law popularization work for more than 30 years has achieved fruitful results, and the public's learning, respecting, upholding, using and abiding by the law have been comprehensively improved. However, with the in-depth promotion of the rule of law, the development of the Internet and the popularization of App, the forms and scope of interpersonal and economic exchanges are diverse, and the public's desire for legal knowledge has become frequent, diverse, pragmatic and complex. With the help of the value information by the big data of “judicial cloud” and the use of data mining and artificial intelligence technology, we can explore an innovative way for accurate law popularization and provide data support, convenient ways, rich content, user feedback and evaluation standards for the accuracy of law popularization.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Graphics Technology and Multi-dimensional Spatial Design of Chinese Fonts
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to study the use of computer graphics technology in the design of Chinese fonts. The two aspects of graphic software and Chinese font design and production, and graphic software and Chinese font multi-dimensional space design are explored to clarify that Chinese font design has moved from static to dynamic, which breaks through the limitations of two-dimensional static of font and realises the multi-dimensional space effect of font polymorphism. Combined with practical cases, we analyse graphic software and its use, 3D art font design methods, explore the use of gloss and material in font design, the combination of graphics and Chinese fonts to produce a sense of dimensionality, and the grid composition of font design with a sense of dimensionality. It is concluded that the multi-dimensional spatial expression of Chinese fonts is inseparable from light, rotation, kinetic, texture, virtual and other means. Clearly, computer graphics technology provides the conditions for the design and creation of Chinese fonts.

articleTitle: Construction of Data-based Government Emergency Language Service Mechanism under Public Crisis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The handling of public crisis has become an important measurement to test the government's ruling ability. A data-based collaborative linkage emergency language service mechanism needs to be built to implement the function of different governments. Therefore, a great amount of language-related data should be collected randomly and analysed with the help of SPSS and other various statistics tools. In this way, how to fast produce the rescue language products, how to put language technology into practice, and how to carry out the language rescue operations, all need to be solved systematically in real life and work. Only by mobilizing the language technical resources and providing needed language services in case of emergency can enhance the national language ability.This paper collects the typical language performance cases of the government in response to public crisis in recent years, and puts forward some suggestions on the construction of emergency language service mechanism and content through qualitative analysis.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch Problem of Power System Considering Valve Point Effect based on Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Economic dispatching problem is a classic problem in power systems. However, traditional economic dispatching problem does not consider the valve point effect. Therefore, a more accurate economic scheduling model with the valve point effect is considered in this paper. At the same time, the introduction of the valve point effect makes the objective function add a non-differentiable term, fruit fly optimization algorithm is employed to solve the newly introduced problem. Traditional fruit fly optimization algorithm does not consider the feasible interval of variables. Therefore, an improved algorithm is proposed in this paper. The simulation results show that the improved algorithm can effectively solve the power system economic dispatch problem considering the valve point effect.

articleTitle: Based on the Mechanical Model of Underwater Tree in Sea Trial Stage
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To explore the deep down the tree down system under the condition of typical mechanical characteristics and influencing factors of the sensitivity of subsea tree down system based on independent improved mechanical model, carry out the deep down stage subsea tree down parameter sensitivity analysis of the process, to establish the working condition of mechanical characteristics of the tree down system. The results show that wave force and current force are the main factors in the deep water lowering stage. With the increase of velocity and wave height of surface current, the transverse displacement, stress and bending moment increase. The velocity of surface current caused the largest increase, followed by wave height; period and wind speed caused no obvious change. The horizontal displacement of the tree is too large in the deep water lowering stage, and the main reason for the docking failure is the sea current force. By converting the sea current velocity into the horizontal displacement, the maximum horizontal displacement is determined to be 2.7m.

articleTitle: Intelligent Tracked Robot Realizes Simple Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Tracked robot have the characteristics of small size, strong flexibility, flexible steerability, and good portability. They can adapt to the complex environment, and realize the surrounding scene. With the rapid development of tracked robot technology, tracked robot is gradually playing an increasingly important role in the fields of work, entertainment, exploration, battlefield, aerospace and so on, has broad application prospects. Mobile tracked robot has a wide range of applications in hazardous environment detection and sampling, urban disaster relief, anti-terrorism and explosive disposal, security and other fields. This paper mainly improves the intelligent tracked robot to realize the detection in unfamiliar environment. This paper conducts simulation experiment step-by-step. Firstly, the basic intelligent functions of the robot are tested and debugged. The simple experiments are carried out. Then, the intelligent functions of the robot are combined for complex experiments. Finally, Comprehensive experiments were carried out in different environments. This paper also analyses the feasibility of applying this robot in the anti-terrorist, providing strong support for the completion of anti-terrorism and rescue tasks.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Virtual Simulation Laboratory for Vehicle Professional Courses from an International Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The virtual simulation laboratory is a process of transforming the one-dimensional text on the original textbook, to the two-dimensional picture projected by PPT, into a lifelike three-dimensional image. Through the multimedia platform, the knowledge and models learned by the students are displayed in front of the students, so that the experiencers can feel a near-real experience on this virtual simulation platform, which can greatly deepen our imagination and understanding of things, let the experience learning is fun. According to the existing situation of experimental teaching in local colleges and universities, this study proposes the establishment of an automobile engine simulation laboratory. On the basis of analyzing the technical implementation status of automobile engine virtual laboratory at home and abroad, comparing the system composition of the traditional laboratory system, synthesizing the current needs, researching and exploring relevant solutions, and finally deciding to conduct a simulation laboratory exploration of the engine, explaining the composition of the virtual laboratory, and understand the utilization and management of laboratories. The basic operations of the virtual laboratory are studied based on real objects and actual operations, and the application of the virtual laboratory is discussed with the engine crankshaft as the research object.

articleTitle: An Identification Method for Indication Value of Digital Display Instruments Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on machine vision, an useful solution are provided in this paper for indication value identification of digital display instruments. In particular, for such key procedures as ROI extracting, grayscale processing and template matching, new methods are invented to achieve a good result.

articleTitle: Research on the framework of Decision Support Platform for the Lower Yellow River Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The decision support platform for the lower Yellow River integrates the models of hydrological, hydrodynamic, sediment transport, reservoir group optimal operation, beach area function planning in order to provide governance and management decision support for managers. To achieve this goal, the platform uses the stability and scalability of cloud computing technology to build a decision support platform for the lower Yellow River Based on cloud computing technology. The platform is composed of IaaS, PaaS and SaaS. The IaaS stores a large number of data resources. The PaaS layer provides services such as scheme management and data management for SaaS layer. Users can call web service interfaces to access required applications. This architecture provides a solution for the water conservancy industry to solve the integration of massive data and water conservancy models.

articleTitle: A Phishing Website Detection Method Based on Multi-layer Perceptron with Mutual Information Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development and wide application of the Internet, security issues have become increasingly prominent. Various Internet security incidents emerged in an endless stream. Of all the cyber threats, phishing websites are one of the biggest threats to users. By spoofing well-known websites, attackers lure users into entering their private information, which can then be used to commit other illegal and criminal activities, harming the Internet environment. Traditional methods that are black and white list-based defenses have shown a significant loss in accuracy in the face of increasingly diverse phishing sites. To solve the problem, a phishing detection method based on multi-layer perceptron with feature selection is proposed, of which architecture is a typical three-layer structure. The procedure of the method includes feature selection and model training. In the feature selection stage, more relevant features to the label are screened according to the mutual information value; in the training stage, the multi-layer perceptron model is trained by using the generated new dataset. Experiments show that the proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy of phishing detection.

articleTitle: Design of a High-reliability Signal Switching Conversion Module
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The use of signal switching and conversion modules can greatly improve the utilization rate of internal space such as ships and submarines. This paper proposes a design scheme of high-reliability signal switching and conversion module to realize the function of two computers sharing a set of display and control equipment. The signal switching conversion module designed in this paper integrates display control interfaces such as DVI, USB, RS232, Ethernet, etc., and has the characteristics of wide application range and high cost performance. Through the redundant combination design of power conversion unit, BMC monitoring unit, DVI switching unit, and USB switching unit, the high reliability of control and display will not be impossible due to a chip failure. The module has the prospect of being applied to high reliability requirements in aerospace, navigation, and military industries.

articleTitle: Construction of Precision Teaching Mode and Teaching Practice Application Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Nowadays, big data has brought great changes to all industries with the rapid development of information technology, including teaching field. The 19th CPC National Congress and the second and third Plenary Sessions of the 19th CPC Central Committee pointed out that it was vital to deepen comprehensive reform in the field of education, adhere to the core concept of the deep integration of information technology and education and teaching, improve the quality of education, and develo the innovative spirit of students. Big data can not only enhance students' learning ability, but also improve teachers' efficiency in teaching. Teachers can make use of big data to make real-time evaluation, comprehensively, efficiently and accurately obtain students' feedback data for analysis, which helps to understand the situation of learning before class and determine teaching based on learning, timely adjust teaching based on learning in class, and review practice after class to promote learning, so as to truly achieve “learning-centered”, promote learning and make teaching accurate and efficient. In this paper, the SPOC mixed teaching mode is constructed based on the teaching status of Fanya platform and the course practice of Front Room Management as the carrier.

articleTitle: Research on the Information Construction Plan of Smart Health and Senior Care Villages
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The information construction of a smart health and senior care village is to achieve the interconnection of various system platforms through the integration of intelligent information platforms in the field of health and senior care through the “Internet +” health and senior care mode. Thus, the data sharing among the government, health and senior care villages and health and senior care people (especially the elderly and children) can be realized, and the information technology can really serve the health and senior care cause and finally the sustainable development of smart health and senior care in China can be accomplished.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Based on Spatiotemporal Saliency and Multiscale Appearance Cue Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, an unsupervised approach for tracking moving targets in videos is proposed. The proposed approach combines multi-scale appearance cues and spatiotemporal saliency. Firstly, the gradient distribution of the optical flow field at lower spatiotemporal scales is analyzed to get a global saliency map, estimating the initial range of the moving target. Then, the structured forest algorithm is used to extract more refined edge information. Appearance clues including HOG, color histogram, color contrast and spatial color variance are fused to describe local spatial information. The spatial saliency map is calculated by the geodesic distance-based method according to the spatial feature difference of superpixels. The temporal saliency map is generated based on the position and color deviation of the superpixels from two adjacent frames. Finally, the global saliency map, the spatial map and the temporal saliency map are fused to obtain the spatiotemporal saliency map, indicating the region of moving targets. Experimental results on two benchmark video datasets show that our approach does not need prior information and can achieve superior experimental results compared with four previous classical algorithms.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Impact of Internet on Consumption Upgrading: Evidence from Rural Residents in China
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The increase of total consumption of rural residents and the optimization and upgrading of consumption structure are the key factors to smooth the great domestic cycle and expand domestic demand. Based on the data of China household Finance Survey in 2017, this paper studies the impact of Internet use on rural residents' consumption behavior. The results show that Internet use plays a positive role in promoting the increase of total household consumption and structural optimization. Internet use ultimately contributes to consumption and consumption upgrading by increasing household income which is the most import factor to improve consumer purchasing power.

articleTitle: Design of Video Codec Platform Based on PowerPC+WW602 Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of dual-channel high-resolution video encoding and decoding, as well as the need for long-term capture and recording of operating terminal screen information in important control scenarios such as shipborne, vehicle-mounted, and airborne, it is convenient for post-event technical analysis, service quality assessment, and exercises. Deduction and determination of responsibility for operation accidents. The hardware architecture of PowerPC+WW602 is researched, and a platform that supports dual-channel high-definition video encoding and decoding is designed and implemented. The compression algorithm of H.264 encoding standard is used to realize the encoding and decoding of video data, and advanced and mature technology is used to follow the generalization. The video codec platform design based on PowerPC+WW602 architecture can support single-channel or dual-channel video input of high-definition and standard-definition, and realize the codec transmission of two channels of video information. The delay of video capture and display is within 30ms, the picture is clear, and the video capture process is not lost.

articleTitle: A Novel Wearable Multi-Channel Pulse Monitor Combined with Machine Learning for Screening Hypertension Population
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Hypertension is a chronic disease that seriously threatens the health of residents. However, the existing studies have difficulty meeting the needs of daily monitoring and screening hypertension. Continuous monitoring of pulse wave provides a novel perspective for screening hypertension groups. In this work, we proposed a novel wearable multi-channel pulse monitor, which can not only simultaneously collect pulse waves from three positions of the human wrist, but also distinguish between hypertension groups and healthy groups. The pulse wave data collected by the monitor undergoes feature extraction in the time domain and preprocessing. Based on mutual information score, we found out and selected top 12 differentiating features between the hypertensive group and the healthy group, and proposed a classification model based on support vector machine, whose accuracy is 96.28% and the F1 score is 0.9744. The experimental results demonstrate the application prospect of pulse wave in hypertension screening and clinical diagnosis, and the monitor has significant research prospects and commercial value.

articleTitle: A Universal Bus Management Method for Multi-Computer Multi-Bus System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: High reliable computer systems mainly adopt the redundant backup methods to construct complex multi-computer multi-bus fault-tolerant systems. How to design the bus management logic is a key problem for these kinds of systems. In this paper, a universal bus management method is introduced to improve the system's fault tolerance ability. The method adopts the global optimization strategy, by scoring all of the possible bus management statuses and finding out the best one. The score of each bus management status is composed by 3 parts: bus score, computer score and interface chip score. There are several adjustable parameters in the scoring logic. By adjusting the parameters, different bus management strategy can be generated. So the proposed method can be widely used. The validity of the bus management method proposed is verified by simulations and experiments on the GNC system of a spacecraft.

articleTitle: A Method for Supplementing the Knowledge Graph of Power User Service
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to reduce the workload of manual supplementation of the knowledge graph of power user service and improve the efficiency of supplementation, a method that can assist manual supplementation of the knowledge graph of power user service is designed. This paper firstly introduces the structure of the knowledge graph of power user service and the design scheme of the graph supplementing method based on human-computer interaction, and defines the questions that need add into graph and the process that how to supplement the knowledge graph. Then, the key technology in the graph supplementing method—user questions matching, is introduced. A deep learning-based user questions matching method is proposed and an algorithm suitable for questions matching in the power user service is selected through experimental comparison. Finally, analysis and summary are carried out.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Strategies of Reading Promotion in University Intelligent Libraries: With Jianghan University Library as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper studies the approaches of reading promotion, the establishment of service platforms, the management and information literacy improvement of readers in university intelligent libraries, and besides, delves into the creative modes of reading promotion to effectively stimulate reading and meet the diverse and personalized reading needs of different groups.

articleTitle: The Connection between Tourism and “Internet +” in the Context of Rural Revitalization: Taking the “red, blue and green” cultural model of Yimeng Mountain as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Under the background of the country's vigorous implementation of the rural revitalization strategy, the development of the “red, blue and green” tourism model in Yimeng Mountain has rich tourism resources, and the rich tourism resources have a role in promoting local economic development. Especially with the rapid development of economic globalization and informatization, the network economy has gradually become an important driving force to promote economic development with the proposal of “Internet +”. “Organically connect the theme concept to create a new brand of characteristic tourism industry; carry out the integration of “red, blue and green” research and study tours to optimize the new path of eco-tourism; demonstrate the confidence of Yimeng's red tourism culture and promote rural economic prosperity.

articleTitle: Wavelet-based Compressive Total Variation for Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: It is one of the main tasks of image processing to recover the original image from the noise polluted image (observed image). In the wavelet transform domain the approximate coefficient matrix of the original image matrix is low-rank, and the corresponding gradient transform matrix is low-rank and sparse. Compressive total variation has excellent performance in image processing when the original image is sparse and low-rank. Based on this prior knowledge, the denoising of the observed image is realized by minimizing an energy functional containing the fitting term and regularization term, and the image is reconstructed by using the inverse wavelet transform.

articleTitle: Study of Interpretation Training on the Development of Foreign-Related Pharmaceutical Enterprises from the Perspective of Artificial Intelligence —Taking Rising of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence (AI), especially for the progress of foreign-related pharmaceutical enterprises, the demand for English interpreting practitioners is increasing. Based on analysis of the perspective of economic development in the Guangdong-HongKong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the study has discussed the training situation of English interpreting learners of higher education from the perspective of AI, while analyzed characteristics on the learning and training in current English interpreting. Moreover, it also puts forward the suitable teaching strategies for the course of English interpreting in higher education, so as to further meet the rising goals of foreign-related enterprises in the Greater Bay Area.

articleTitle: A Reliable Reset Method for Softcore Microprocessor Symtem
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Softcore microprocessor is a microprocessor implemented by FPGA logic synthesis. It significantly improves the flexibility of FPGA, and had been widely used in a variety of scenarios. In softcore microprocessor systems, the microprocessor logical, program runtime memory logical and memory data initialization are established at the same time during FPGA configuration operation. Conventional microprocessor reset methods, such as activating microprocessor reset pin or executing exception vector, do not perform FPGA configuration operation, and data in program runtime memory remains unchanged after reset. The missing of memory data initialization leads to program execution exception after reset. This paper proposed a reliable reset method for softcore microprocessor system in FPGA, a reset management module is induced to control microprocessor reset process and insert memory data initialization process. The experiment results verified the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Design of a Programmable Touch Keyboard
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to further improve the utilization rate of equipment, reduce the dependence on other countries' components, realize the independent control of equipment, and further enhance the scientific and technological strength. This paper proposes a programmable touch keyboard design scheme, which realizes that the display console can carry out different command control according to different scenarios and different application environments. The programmable touch keyboard device can support a variety of mainstream communication protocols, support USB, NET, RS232 and other interfaces, can communicate with the computer through each communication port, process the data of the computer and display it on the programmable touch keyboard interface, and feedback the data processing results to the computer. Programmable touch keys have 100% self-study, programmable display, multi-touch, high resolution, low power consumption, resistance to harsh environments, strong stability and other notable features. Compared with the traditional keyboard that can only display fixed text and a single interface, the programmable touch keyboard proposed in this paper can redefine each key many times according to the scene, and can display multi-interface commands to meet different command requirements.

articleTitle: Exploring the Seismogenic Structure of the 2016 Yanhu Earthquake Swarm Using Template-based Recognition Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To improve our knowledge about earthquake swarm sequences in the Shanxi region, the template matched filtering technique was used to detect missed seismic events in the Yanhu earthquake swarm, resulting in 133 new locatable earthquakes being added, twice that of the original catalog. Next, using information on the 2016 Yanhu magnitude 4.4 earthquake swarm sequence, the precise locations of the aftershocks, focal mechanism of the mainshock, and seismotectonics were determined. Analysis of the epicenter distribution revealed that the tectonics of this earthquake differed from that of the previous swarm-type earthquakes generated in this region, as it had relatively simple tectonic units and occurred near the north-shore rupture of Yanhu. The results of the double-difference precise earthquake location analysis showed that the aftershocks were predominantly distributed in the northwest (NW) direction. Through fine localization, the focal depth was determined to be concentrated in the range of 1–20 km, with an average depth of 8.33 km, and the mainshock occurred at the end of the sequence. The deep spreading of the sequence was consistent with the focal mechanism solution obtained using the cut-and-paste method. The dislocation event of the mainshock in this sequence was a strike-slip-cum-thrust fault, and the strike and dip of the nodal plane I parameters were close to each other, indicating a high-angle slip fault. It was concluded that the sequence of the Yanhu earthquake swarm was dominantly distributed in the NW direction, and the precise localization results combined with the local mechanism solution indicate that the swarm was a NW-trending buried rupture earthquake.

articleTitle: An Abnormal Behavior Detection Method based on Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to achieve better detection of abnormal behaviors in the crowd and solve the problems of low efficiency and poor accuracy of traditional methods, this paper proposes a feature extraction method for abnormal behavior detection in video. A standard reference library is established for extracted target feature information in normal videos. The target of abnormal video is detected by using gray scale change algorithm. The singular value matrix decomposes the selected object and obtains the corresponding parameter index value. A Bayesian classifier is used to compare the obtained feature parameter indicator values with the thresholds in the standard reference library. The feature points are smaller than the thresholds of the standard reference library, which are considered as abnormal behavior. Compared with the existing detection methods, the proposed abnormal behavior detection recognition accuracy rate is over 90%. The experimental comparison results show that the detection effect is not only higher accuracy, and stronger anti-interference ability, but also faster detection speed.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Countermeasure of SM4 against Side Channel Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper presents a lightweight countermeasure scheme of SM4 cryptographic algorithm against side channel analysis attacks. SM4 is one of the widely used block ciphers in information computing and data communication. However, as it is usually implemented in cryptographic devices, it is definitely under the threat of side channel analysis attacks. Some schemes of implementations have been provided as the countermeasures against the side channel analysis attacks, which leads to a relatively complicated realization on both cost and performance. This paper proposes a new mask scheme for SM4 implementation with lightweight cost and low performance loss. Experiment results show the effectiveness of the method against the side channel analysis attacks.

articleTitle: Comparison between Human Translation and Machine Translation in Translating the Publicity Text of Haihunhou Museum
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In 2016, there were amount of news of new technological breakthroughs in the field of machine translation at home and abroad. Whether machine translation can replace human translation has become one of the hot topics in academic circles. This paper argues that in specific restricted language translation, machines translation has provided people with convenient and efficient services, but on the whole, the translation quality of machine translation is not as good as human translation and can not replace human translation in a short time. Translation quality assessment is an important sub task in the field of machine translation. At present, translation quality assessment has a good performance in Chinese-English, English-German machine translation, and the technology is relatively mature. However, applying the model to the machine translation of Haihunhou publicity text still has many problems. Compared with the parallel corpus of manual translation, the differences of machine translation in terms translation, vocabulary discrimination, syntactic analysis and symbol translation in Haihunhou publicity text provide a corpus analysis basis for improving the machine translation system.

articleTitle: The Inverse Eigenvalue Problem of Tridiagonal Matrix with Proportional Relationships
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The matrix eigenvalue inverse problem is the problem of inversely determining the matrix by using the information of the known eigenvalues and eigenvectors and other constraints. The matrix eigenvalue inverse problem is not only deeply studied in the field of mathematics, but also in other engineering fields Both have a very wide range of applications. This paper studies the inverse eigenvalue problem of a class of tridiagonal matrices with proportional relationships, constructs a matrix by given two eigenpairs, and obtains an algorithm for inverting the matrix. At the same time, the corresponding. The uniqueness theorem of, and the validity of the algorithm is verified by numerical examples.

articleTitle: GPU-based Real-time Image Mosaicing for UAVs
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Facing the problem of large amount of UAV image data, multiple redundancies and uneven quality, this paper proposes a GPU-based UAV real-time image mosaicing technology. First, the video stream data captured by the UAV is decoded to obtain frame images. Then, for these large number of frames images, pre-processing such as cache frame extraction and geometric correction is performed to obtain high quality and low redundancy UAV images. Extracting image feature points and matching them by SIFT, SURF, etc., and screening matching points by RANSAC algorithm. Finally, based on the screened matching points, image fusion is performed to obtain the UAV mosaicing image. The overall process is parallel accelerated by GPU, which is more efficient and real-time. The mosaiced images can be tile-cut and stored in chunks to achieve fast sharing and efficient application of image data.

articleTitle: New Untrained Emitter Detection Based on SK-GAND Network
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The increasing complexity of the spatial electromagnetic environment has triggered the need to discriminate individuals with unknown radiation sources, and the recognition effect of traditional deep networks and other methods based on supervised learning is poor. To address the problem of identifying new untrained devices in RF fingerprinting, this paper proposes an unsupervised SK-GAND neural network-based method for detecting new untrained radiation sources, adding the SK module to the traditional GAN network and setting two thresholds γand ω for identifying trained and new radiation sources. The thresholds <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$y$</tex> and ω are determined by training the difference between the samples obtained in the SK-GAND network for the existence of encoding and decoding re-encoding, and a multi-discriminator model is used to determine whether the input radiation source samples are new untrained sources. Based on the experimental comparison of different numbers of radiation sources, the detection effectiveness is obtained up to 80% for up to 12 sources and up to 90% for up to 5 sources.

articleTitle: Identification of Aerodynamic Parameters Based on Maximum Likelihood Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the requirement of aerodynamic parameters in the design of electric aircraft control system, an identification of aerodynamic parameters algorithm based on maximum likelihood estimation is proposed. Firstly, the Bryan linear aerodynamic model is used to derive the state equation and observation equation needed for identification; then based on the maximum likelihood estimation criterion and combined with the Newton-Raphson optimization algorithm, the identification of aerodynamic parameters in the equation is realized; finally, the algorithm is verified by using the longitudinal simulation data of an electric aircraft flight. The identification results show that our algorithm has high identification accuracy, strong anti-interference, fast convergence and good engineering practicability under the step input, doublet input and 3211 form input.

articleTitle: Design and Development of the Cultural Tourism Big Data Platform Based on Internet + Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the background of wisdom tourism with Internet and cloud computing, the author introduces the main functions of the cultural tourism big data platform from the aspects of tourist transportation, catering and accommodation and the intellectualization of tourism organization, and analyzes the design and realization path of the system. It has been proved by practice that strengthening the application of Internet and cloud computing technology can effectively improve the effect of the cultural tourism big data platform construction, which is conducive to the healthy and sustainable development of overall cultural tourism industry, so as to promote the career of rural revitalization.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of County-level Natural Resource Integration Information Platform in Guangxin District of Shangrao City
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to actively respond to the national optimization of the business environment, fully integrate the responsibilities of the original land resources, planning and other departments, promoting the overall high-quality development of the regional digital economy by means of information technology has become a current priority. However, the natural resources sector has existing problems such as data islands, scattered business, and longtime consumption. Taking Guangxin District, Shangrao City as an example, this paper proposes to construct the integrated information platform of natural resources in the county area by utilizing advanced technologies such as multi-user concurrent access, long-term transaction processing, and integrated data model-driven database building technology, comprehensively enhance the informatization level and open-sharing ability of grassroots units, and improve the level of refinement and intelligence of management, which has certain reference significance for the construction work in other similar areas.

articleTitle: Research on Heat Sealing Effect of Carton Film Based on ANSYS Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Six-plane beautification device of carton transparent paper is designed in order to solve these problems, such as slack, wrinkles and so on. This device is mainly composed of iron and drive mechanism. When working, the iron is branded to form an accommodation cavity, and the carton is placed in the accommodation cavity to beautify six plane of the carton. According to the material parameters of the cigarette film, the finite element mathematical model of the cigarette film was established by using the ANSYS software, the heat-sealing temperature was the load, the thermal conduction of the film was simulated, and through further practical tests to determine the optimal shaping temperature. This test is taking cigarette named Liqun LWL produced by G10 Packaging machine of Ningbo cigarette Factory as the Research object. It shows that after the installation of the device, the cigarette was eliminated from 60 / shift to 10 / shift due to the packaging defects of transparent paper in the carton. This device is able to provide technical support for improving the packaging quality of carton transparent paper.

articleTitle: Evaluating Steel Quality via the Feature Engineering Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Steel's performance is usually tested by a set of evaluation index system and the testing result is issued in formal reports. The reports are difficult to satisfy the steel quality analysis for long-term evaluation from different dimension. To evaluate the strength quality of steel, based on feature engineering method, we identify the data attributes and clean the raw data from steel strength test report first, and then construct the dynamic features of its mean, variance, and coefficient of variation using time window method for different dimension. Finally, integrate the multi-feature evaluation result. Experimental results show that the data definition is no redundancy and by time window dynamic feature the quality evaluation become more flexible for material control and achieve better result effectively.

articleTitle: Exploring the “Trinity” Model of Training Artificial Intelligence Talents
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the deepening globalization of science and technology, the importance of artificial intelligence technology has become increasingly prominent, the competition for talents has become increasingly fierce, and many countries have made the cultivation of talents a vital force in promoting the development of artificial intelligence. However, the current model of cultivating intelligent talents is outdated, with problems such as weak discipline construction, single-course training, and lack of practical experience. In the pursuit of cultivating talents with the overall development of knowledge, ability, and quality, the “trinity” training model based on artificial intelligence is built to provide high-level, open, and complex, intelligent talents for economic and social development.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Digital Intelligence College-Enterprise Cooperation Sharing System of Modern Logistics Management Specialty in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In “Opinions on Promoting the High-quality Development of Modern Vocational Education”, college-enterprise cooperation is especially proposed as an important means of vocational education development. There are some problems in the college-enterprise cooperation of modern logistics management major in higher vocational colleges, such as the inability of enterprises and colleges to share resources effectively, the mismatch between enterprise post demand and college personnel training, and the inconsistency between teaching objectives and industry development. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes the construction of digital intelligence college-enterprise cooperation personnel training sharing information platform, digital intelligence college-enterprise cooperation personnel assessment sharing system and teacher sharing teaching system based on digital intelligence college-enterprise cooperation personnel training information platform.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Training Room for Optical Device Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The optical device industry is in the middle of the optical communication industry chain. According to the real operation process of the optical device production line of the enterprise, purchasing equipment, building a training room in the school and carrying out project-based teaching play a very important role in cultivating high-quality and highly skilled application-oriented talents in the industry. Training projects are designed according to the typical production process of typical optical device products, and each project is a complete production or testing process. Through practical training, students can master the basic theoretical knowledge of typical optical devices, learn to use the instruments and equipment in the production process, understand the process flow, and learn to use industry standards to monitor and measure the performance parameters of optical devices.

articleTitle: AIDNet: Detecting Insulators and Defects from Satellite Remote Sensing Images: An Exploration
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The insulator has a diameter of about 200 mm and occupies only 0.4 pixels in the best satellite remote sensing image (SRSI). Detecting insulators and self-explosion defects from SRSI is a challenging task due to the extremely low spatial resolution and mixed pixels issues. Algorithm design that improves the required spatial resolution (rSR) is one way to advance this task. This paper proposes a two-stage detection method combining an adaptive network and a detection network, using multiple filtering and adaptive enhancement methods to achieve end-to-end detection, which can effectively improve the rSR. The idea proposed in this paper can promote the realization of goals that detect insulators and defects from SRSI. The proposed algorithm can realize the detection at relatively poor spatial resolution, and can be applied to small targets detection in general object detection tasks.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Virtual Reality Technology in the Teaching of Modern Logistics Equipment Course of modern Logistics Management major in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the problems existing in the teaching scene of modern logistics equipment, and focuses on the significance of constructing the sharing platform of modern logistics equipment course teaching system based on virtual reality technology by introducing VR technology. The advantages of virtual reality technology in modern logistics equipment teaching are summarized. Finally, it is concluded that the application of virtual reality technology in the teaching of modern logistics equipment can effectively improve students' interest in learning and improve the teaching effect of the course.

articleTitle: Study on Optimizing the Flow Field of Cold Air System in Cold Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the situation that the operating temperature of the large-scale cold storage does not meet the standard during the operation of the cold storage, the basic principles of fluid dynamics are used to conduct scientific numerical simulation and analysis of the overall cold air circulation flow field of the cold storage through the Fluent software of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) In order to find the shortcomings in the operation of the cold storage, to solve the existing problems and shortcomings while taking into account the economy and rationality of the cold storage operation, scientifically propose solutions to improve the heat exchange efficiency of the cold storage and the reliability design and correct use of the cold storage. Scientific and technological theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Design of 5G Vehicle-road-cloud Collaborative Architecture for Vehicle Platooning
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper presents an architecture design of vehicle-road-cloud collaboration based on a 5g communication network, which supports vehicle platooning and applies it in the case of vehicle formation crossing the border. The architecture includes roadside, cloud systems, 5g network, and infrastructure deployment connecting vehicles, as well as specifications for interfaces of automated vehicles (network communication interface specifications and application interface specifications). In addition, solutions and simple tests are proposed for the cross-border problems in the case of vehicle platooning crossing the border, mainly including interconnection delay between PLMNs, and low delay communication between leader and team members' vehicles and roadside infrastructure.

articleTitle: Design of High Precision Cigarette Online Sampling Device
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the application background of PROTOS70 cigarette machine widely used in the tobacco industry, this paper designs and implements a high-precision online cigarette sampling device, which can automatically sample the cigarettes produced by the cigarette machine online and send them to the C2 cigarette quality detector. The results show that the system can realize the function of cigarette non-destructive sampling, improve the degree of cigarette detection automation, prevent the occurrence of batch quality accidents, and realize the intellectualization of cigarette quality control.

articleTitle: Research on Noise Control and Simulation Optimization of Cooling Fan in Ship Display Console
publicationTitle: 2022 8th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The display console is a very important part for the ship's electronic information system. In order to study the noise characteristics and effectively control the noise value of the cooling fan in ship display console.
